principle: Test as 5 different end-users. Each has different needs.

personas.name: Regulator (EU AI Office)
needs: Verify compliance with EU AI Act Art 50
Cite the DOI in a regulatory filing
Check the EU AI Act attestation in /signed/
personas.outcome: Can verify EU AI Act Art 50 compliance in 1 minute

personas.name: AI lab researcher (Anthropic)
needs: Get a signed card for the measurement
Compare Claude vs GPT-4 vs Gemini
personas.outcome: Can measure + sign + anchor + verify any model in 1 minute

personas.name: Insurance company (Munich Re)
needs: Attest AI risk for an underwriting decision
Use the card in an insurance policy
Cite the DOI in a regulatory filing
personas.outcome: Can attest + cite + pay for risk in 1 minute

personas.name: Crypto fund (Paradigm)
needs: Anchor the attestation to OTS + Bitcoin
personas.outcome: Can verify + anchor + self-custody XRPL attestation in 1 minute

personas.name: Sovereign wealth fund (Norwegian Oil Fund)
needs: Cite the DOI in a fund allocation
Buy GSPC measurement for AI in their portfolio
personas.outcome: Can cite + read + verify + buy measurement in 1 minute
